title: OPEN ARMS feat ROWETTA - Somebody (Clock's Peaktime House)

lines.l: I need somebody, somebody, somebody, somebody, somebody
You try to do your best but you fail to see
You lied, but it could never be
You tried, you said you'd be everything for me
You lied, you took a very part of me
First you say you want me
Then you say you need me
But you know that it can't be
That way for you and me
